services.name: Public Cruises
services.desc: Join us on our Canada Day Fireworks Cruise, for a unique and memorable experience watching fireworks on the water. 11,000 sq ft of sail billowing above as you take in the breathtaking scenery of Toronto’s city skyline at night, onboard Canada’s largest sailing ship. This cruise features a three and a half hour harbour and lake cruise and a full dinner buffet. Complimentary coffee & tea as well a cannon fire to celebrate the event. Join us on our Airshow Cruise, for an exciting afternoon of aerial acrobatics and stunning views of the city skyline onboard Canada’s largest sailing ship. blurb: Guests sail aboard a historic three-masted schooner originally built in 1943, experiencing Toronto Harbour and Lake Ontario with views of the city skyline and islands. The ship offers public themed cruises and private charters for various occasions with indoor and outdoor spaces. Dining and beverage options are available onboard, with professional crew service.
